_comment: Browser sign-in config. No client secret lives here or anywhere in this repo — the secret is held only by the OAuth proxy (see oauth-proxy/). After deploying the proxy, set proxy_url to your Worker URL (e.g. https://omarchy-slack-oauth.<subdomain>.workers.dev). The 'Sign in with Slack' button appears once proxy_url is set. Users can override this file at ~/.config/omarchy-slack/oauth.json to point at their own app + proxy.
